parameters.help_en: The subscription type. Valid value: PayAsYouGo
parameters.help_zh: 订阅类型。取值类型：PayAsYouGo（后付费）
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region

fields.help_en:
The code of the Nth pricing module.

Obtain the module code by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html operation
fields.help_zh:
第n个计价模块的模块标识。


可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html接口获取Module参数
fields.name: module_code

fields.help_en:
The price type of the Nth pricing module. Valid values:

Hour: hourly price.

Usage: usage.

Month: monthly price.

Year: yearly price.

Obtain the price type by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html operation
fields.help_zh:
第n个计价模块的价格类型，取值范围：
Hour：小时价。
Usage：使用量。
Month：月价。
Year：年价。

可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html接口获取Module参数
fields.name: price_type

fields.help_en:
The configuration of the Nth pricing module. The value of N can be an integer from 1 to 50. The configuration is in the "AA:aa,BB:bb" format. In this format, AA and BB are the property codes of the pricing module, and aa and bb are the property values.

Obtain the configuration by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html operation
fields.help_zh:
第n个计价模块的配置，n的取值范围为（1~50），格式：“AA:aa,BB:bb”，其中AA,BB分别为计价模块属性标识，aa,bb分别为计价模块属性的属性值。

可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96469.html接口获取Module参数
fields.name: config
